data.description: Major transit hub with direct weekly vessel sailings from Mundra and Nhava Sheva (JNPT).
Strict adherence to EU MRL thresholds, aflatoxin testing, and ethylene oxide (ETO) absence declarations.
FDA FSMA compliant documentation, automated US Customs filing, and fumigation certificates.
Rapid feeder connections across ASEAN ports for agro commodities and raw materials.

data.question: What is your standard Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?
data.answer: Our standard export minimum order quantity is one 20ft Full Container Load (FCL), which corresponds to approximately 18–24 Metric Tonnes (MT) depending on commodity density. For high-potency standardized botanical extracts and pharmaceutical-grade ingredients, we accommodate trial LCL shipments starting at 100 kg to 500 kg.

data.question: Can we combine multiple commodities in a single container (Mixed FCL)?
data.answer: Yes. For food distributors and specialty retail importers, we routinely arrange multi-commodity consolidated 20ft and 40ft containers (e.g. 10 MT Basmati Rice + 5 MT Whole Spices + 3 MT Lentils), provided the cargo items share compatible temperature and humidity storage standards.

data.question: What international payment terms do you accept?
data.answer: We operate under international commercial banking standards. Standard terms are: (1) 30% advance deposit via Telegraphic Transfer (TT), balance 70% payable against scanned copies of the Bill of Lading, Phytosanitary Certificate, and commercial invoice. (2) Irrevocable Letter of Credit (LC) at sight issued by a prime international commercial bank.

data.question: Which Incoterms 2020 do you quote under?
data.answer: We provide binding quotations under ICC Incoterms 2020. Our primary quoting terms are: FOB (Free on Board at Mundra or Nhava Sheva/JNPT ports), CIF (Cost, Insurance, and Freight delivered to your discharge port), and CFR (Cost and Freight). On special request, we can also provide EXW (Ex-Works from our Gujarat or Maharashtra processing plants).

data.question: What mandatory shipping and customs documents are provided with each consignment?
data.answer: Every container export bill includes: (1) Clean on Board Ocean Bill of Lading (3 originals + 3 non-negotiable copies), (2) Commercial Invoice and Detailed Packing List, (3) Certificate of Origin (issued by Chamber of Commerce or Export Inspection Agency), (4) Official Phytosanitary Certificate issued by Plant Quarantine authority, (5) Certificate of Fumigation, and (6) Lot-specific Certificate of Analysis (COA) from an accredited NABL testing lab.

data.question: Do you provide lab Certificate of Analysis (COA) prior to dispatch?
data.answer: Yes. Every production lot undergoes mandatory chemical and physical testing before container stuffing. We provide pre-shipment COAs certifying moisture levels, purity percentages, active marker concentrations (e.g. Curcumin % via HPLC), and testing for aflatoxins, pesticide residues, and heavy metals. On buyer request, independent inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas, or Intertek can be conducted at the port of loading.

data.question: Do you support custom Private Label (OEM) packaging?
data.answer: Yes. Our processing infrastructure offers comprehensive contract manufacturing and custom private labeling. We support retail packaging ranging from 100g to 5kg standing zip pouches, heat-sealed clear bags, HDPE jars, and branded outer master cartons, formatted to satisfy FDA (US), EFSA (EU), or GSO (GCC) regulatory labeling requirements.
